Built on experience. Driven by solutions.

ATC Industries, part of The Shah Group of Companies, has manufactured engineering polymer components since 1996.

Our multi-process capability lets OEM customers source injection-molded, extruded, blow-molded, thermoformed and high-frequency-welded components from one group, across four manufacturing units.

Home appliances
Inlet and outlet hoses, bellows, rear covers, drain assemblies
Telecom
Fabric, thermoformed and polycarbonate radomes for antennas
Automotive & industrial
Profiles, molded components and formed component trays
